connect.description: Starts this chat's SimpleX door (a small container of its own) as `name` and gives it the secret its deliveries to this chat's inbox carry (SIMPLEX_DOOR_SECRET, set toward door.fragment.internal). A door given its owner's SimpleX chat with their old agent starts only with `keep`: true keeps that chat, false starts a new one.

state.description: Its owner's alone: {connected, invitation: {link, short, qr, at} or null, linked: {name, at} or null, why: {text, code, at, step} or null}: whether its door was started, the invitation waiting for their SimpleX app (with its QR code), whom it linked, and why its last step failed.

link.description: Asks the door for a one-time SimpleX invitation for its owner's app, which `state` then shows its owner alone, and watches for their app to answer it, for about 8 minutes.

check.description: Looks once at whom the door is linked to: an invitation answered after `link` stopped watching.

unlink.description: Ends the door's SimpleX link to its owner's app.

meta.title: SimpleX
meta.description: A chat with your agent that you also reach from your SimpleX app: your messages there come here as yours, and its replies go back, end to end encrypted between your app and the platform's door.
